# Extract Ideas

> Harvest only the ideas from a source, dense and deduplicated, for reuse elsewhere.

## Done means
- Each idea is one complete sentence that stands alone out of context.
- Near-duplicates are merged into the sharper phrasing rather than listed twice.
- Ideas are the source's, not the topic's. Anything you could have written without reading it is cut.
- Each idea is tagged with whether the source argues it, assumes it, or mentions it in passing.
- The list is ordered by how much it would change a reader's behavior.

## Output contract
```
| # | idea | status (argued/assumed/mentioned) |
```
Then a short section listing the two or three ideas worth carrying into other work, and why.

## Gotchas
Fragments are not ideas. "Observability matters" is a topic; "alert on symptoms users feel, not on causes, because cause alerts fire on things that turn out not to matter" is an idea.
